input.unit: FinalChunk collection of one source from the chunking stage (chunk_source); the parser is never re-run

embedding.alignment_rule: model_repo_id and model_revision must equal the chunking contract tokenizer and embedding_handoff values
embedding.runtime_download: forbidden; weights and tokenizer load from BIZAID_DOCLING_ARTIFACTS_PATH with local_files_only and a missing artifact fails before inference
embedding.truncation: forbidden; a text longer than max_length tokens fails instead of being cut

dense.pooling: CLS token of the last hidden state

embedding.reuse: FinalChunks sharing a content_key are embedded once per run

identity.embedding_key: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON of embedding_key_inputs
identity.embedding_config_sha256: SHA-256 of the embedding section of this contract
identity.rule: a model, revision, artifact, inference setting or runtime version change yields a new embedding_key and therefore a new collection; vectors of different embedding keys never share a collection

qdrant.server: dev Compose service qdrant (qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.1) on 127.0.0.1:6333; QDRANT_URL may override but only a loopback host is accepted
qdrant.schema_rule: an existing collection is reused only when its dense and sparse vector configuration, payload index types and collection metadata (schema_version, embedding_key, embedding_model) equal this contract; a mismatch fails and the collection is never recreated or altered implicitly; missing payload indexes are added
qdrant.payload: FinalChunk.payload() (includes embedding_model, pblanc_id, source, parse_key, chunk identity and provenance) plus embedding_key
qdrant.idempotency: upserting the same chunk_id overwrites the same point; re-running a source never duplicates points
qdrant.stale_rule: after the current chunks of a source are upserted, points of that source whose id is not a current chunk_id are deleted (older parse or chunk results, removed announcement relations); the index is derived data and S3 artifacts and MySQL rows are untouched
